title: The Ass and the Grasshoppers Wisdom
summary: An ass admired the music of grasshoppers and asked what they ate to sing so sweetly....
full_text:
An ass admired the music of grasshoppers and asked what they ate to sing so sweetly.

The insects told him they drank only dew. The ass stopped eating grain and clover, licking only morning dew from the leaves until he perished of starvation, proving that imitation of another's nature brings ruin.
moral: Desiring another’s natural gifts without their constitution brings starvation.
